summary: Practise QGIS workflows for mine survey data, surface checks, volumes, and operational maps. Review the five-day course outline.
lede: QGIS for mine survey work helps surveyors and mine technical staff prepare, check, analyse, and present spatial data for operations. You’ll practise importing and validating GNSS and total-station files, checking coordinate systems, editing mine features, and comparing elevation surfaces for volume checks. The course also covers map layouts and project packaging for operational handover, using supplied sample data without requiring programming.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who prepare, check, analyse, or communicate spatial survey information for mine operations. It suits intermediate users who have basic QGIS experience or routinely handle digital survey files.
audience: Mine Operations Planners using survey maps
modules: QGIS Project CRS and Coordinate Control
GNSS and Total Station Data Intake
QGIS Volume Checks for Mine Production
QGIS Print Layout for Survey Handover
QGIS Quality Review and Project Packaging
prerequisites: Bring basic QGIS familiarity and experience handling digital survey or spatial files. No programming is required. Install QGIS on your laptop before the course; supplied sample files support the practical exercises.
